findings.message: This HTML composition file has 456 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: ".chip" has CSS `transform: translate(-50%,-50%)` and a GSAP tween animates x/y/scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translate(-50%,-50%)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50. Example: tl.fromTo('.chip', { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50 }, { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: GSAP tween on "#cur-nova" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left, top. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left/top with the transform equivalent (x, y), e.g. tl.fromTo("#cur-nova", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#col-progress .card:last-child .fill" for width between 4.40s and 4.60s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#col-queued .card:last-child" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 1.52s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.
